notes.title: A new strategy game with terraforming - Revival: Recolonization!
notes.content:
Greetings!

Our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306770/Revival_Recolonization/]Revival: Recolonization[/url] comes out today at 09:00 am PDT. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306770/Revival_Recolonization/ 

It's a 4x strategy game set on Earth after the apocalypse caused by the AI uprising. Lead one of the survivor clans, change the climate and landscape with high technology, create unique combat units by combining different types of weapons, fight against automatons and zombies, and make humanity great again. 

[previewyoutube=HLzw-sz9nts;full][/previewyoutube]

Buy the game at a 10% discount for yourself or as a gift for your friend. 
Dive into the fascinating world of Revival: Recolonization with us!

notes.title: Play the new turn-based strategy demo – Revival: Recolonization!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Do you love sci-fi, strategy or post-apocalyptic settings? Try the demo of our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306770/Revival_Recolonization/]Revival: Recolonization[/url]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306770/Revival_Recolonization/

Revival is a 4x turn-based strategy game where you will have to revive the human civilization destroyed by an out-of-control AI.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_91e7d6f739914519a0a04c47365a506d~mv2.gif [/img]

Lead a people of survivors, learn the science, evolve, use advanced technologies to change the climate and landscape of the planet, combine different types of weapons and create unusual combat units. 

Add the game to your Wishlist and share the news with your friends!

notes.title: New card roguelite and 2D action platformer for you and your friends
notes.content:
Greetings!

Great news! Today we are announcing two new games. Watch the trailers and add them to your Wishlist.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088770/Deck_of_Souls/]Deck of Souls[/url] is a souls-like roguelite card game with RPG elements. Create your own hero and break out of an endless cycle of enemies and deaths to close the gates of hell. Retrieve the souls of defeated enemies, turn them into cards, and assemble the most powerful deck!

[previewyoutube=CwPWsqLhv3c;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892100/HEART_ABYSS/]Heart Abyss[/url] is the ultimate cruelty, tense battles shaded by a peaceful relaxing environment, the freedom of improvisation, two playable characters each with their own personality, gameplay features, and storyline. 

[previewyoutube=pNLsaQx3Exs;full][/previewyoutube]

Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088770/Deck_of_Souls/]Deck of Souls[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892100/HEART_ABYSS/]Heart Abyss[/url] to your Wishlist and share the news with your friends!

notes.title: Try your hand at the new economic blacksmith simulation game, Anvil Saga!
notes.content:
Friends! 

While Odysseus spends his time in the company of a robot on a spaceship, we invite you to play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587540/Anvil_Saga/]Anvil Saga[/url], an unforgettable journey as a blacksmith during the Hundred Years' War.

[previewyoutube=k2rnvbT3zFw;full][/previewyoutube]

Anvil Saga is available in Early Access starting today. And you can grab it at a discount for a limited time.

Do you have what it takes to build a profitable business, become the most famous blacksmith in the province, and beat out your rival? Let's find out! 

Head to the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587540/Anvil_Saga/] Anvil Saga Steam page[/url] and add it to your cart!

notes.title: Episode 5 is out! Enjoy the story finale!
notes.content:
The day we have all been waiting for has finally come! 

Episode 5 (season finale) is out today! The journey that took 1,5 years since Episode 1 released (30 years of in-game time for Odysseus - the game’s main character!) will finally be completed.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iL8vMF9fCms

Episode 5 brings answers to all of your questions, as well as cool new stuff:

[list]
[*] teaming up with your crew and unexpected discoveries that will follow
[*] time travel and changing heroes’ fates
[*] Barton’s secrets uncovered - what’s the mystery behind San Francisco’s most charismatic robot?
[*] play as Ada as the story comes to a gripping conclusion
[*] aaaaaaand a mysterious Artifact
[/list]

Now you can buy the whole season (including Episode 5) at a discount right here:

If you’ve already bought the game, all you have to do is update it on Steam and voila! The whole season is at your disposal! [b]35% [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/645820/Odysseus_Kosmos_and_his_Robot_Quest_Complete_Season/

On behalf of the game’s creator Pavel Kostin, the artist Roman Gecerov and the publishing team at HeroCraft, we would like to thank you for your attention and for supporting lovingly crafted indie games! 

And now, its time to fasten your seat belts because this ship is heading for the stars!

notes.title: 9 days to go: announcing a FREE Deluxe Set (time limited offer)!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/b162f7a9ce735710bdb2ffb68a6cccb4441c0a8c.png[/img]
Hello everyone! Just 9 days left until Episode 5 releases on Steam, so we’ve prepared a very special announcement to make this affair even sweeter. 

As a thank you for your continued enthusiasm for Odysseus Kosmos and support for high quality adventure titles, we will be making the upcoming Digital Deluxe Set DLC available for free during the first week of launch. After this period, the Deluxe Set will be distributed with an appropriate price tag, so this is your chance to get it for free.

What's inside this Digital Deluxe Set? Let’s find out!

[b]Digital Art Book[/b]
Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest is the game that pays homage to good old adventure games of the golden era and the elements of sci-fi in popular culture. This digital art book (pdf format) contains pages full of concept art and sketches — everything that helped create the fascinating (and occasionally tragic or humorous) world of Odysseus Kosmos.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/94881ff948548a2771303346756bc18568f70922.jpg[/img]

You can expect to see works made by such artists as Roman Gecerov, Sergey ‘Yoksel’ Dobrecov and other talented individuals who helped define the game’s look.
[b]
Digital Guide Book[/b]

Have you ever found yourself confused with the complexity of sci-fi stories? All the technical jargon, parallel universes, etc. Fear not, as this guide book (pdf format) will give you a detailed look at the timeline of Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest. It contains illustrated pages that introduce readers to some of the key events from the actual game. Why did humanity leave Earth? What is StarGaze and what was their role in launching San Francisco? These and many other questions will be answered in the digital guide book, so don’t miss your chance to get it and brag to your friends about it! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/49800e058217da4fa8ac9185ba8c6431e30b0ffa.jpg[/img]

[b]Original Soundtrack[/b]

Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest’s OST offers 20 tracks (mp3, 320 kbps) inspired by the Soviet space race era. Based heavily on the dialogues and personalities of the main characters, it dramatically evolves with the game’s plot itself. A brainchild of Princess & Ivan Holodov (Creatorium Sound Design), it gives the pixelated universe of Odysseus Kosmos that specific nostalgic feel when space travel was the biggest news around the world. Here’s a preview:   

[url=https://soundcloud.com/roo-kee-krew-kee/sets/odysseus-kosmos-and-his-robot-quest-the-game-ost][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/a9ad8acf61edff8689d6f4d44ea8427cb16670e2.png[/img][/url]

So what’s next?

Episode V will launch in exactly 9 days on April 17th @ 8pm GMT+3 / 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT. The launch will also be accompanied by a live stream on our Steam page! Come share the moment with us :)

notes.title: Episode 5 coming in 2 weeks!
notes.content:
Dear friends! 

Odysseus's great journey is coming to an end with the release of [b]Episode 5[/b] on [b]April 17th.  [/b]

The crew of the scientific ship San-Francisco, which went missing thirty years ago, has finally returned. We are one step away from uncovering all of the secrets behind their disappearance, Barton’s strange behavior, Ada’s identity and all of the weird stuff happening on a huge and seemingly empty spaceship.

Players will also get to visit the past via Ada and [i]maybe [/i]create a few parallel universes?

Get ready for some high octane scientific entertainment ;) The Artifact, amazing discoveries and  tragic sacrifices are waiting. Just like in those sci-fi movies, but under your guidance.

Only two weeks left before Episode 5 releases. The countdown begins now.

Please note that by purchasing the game, you get access to the whole season (Ep. 1-5). Episode 5 will automatically become available in your Steam library after it launches. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/6dc34f580703e731094f99bae6933e48d834635f.png[/img]

notes.title: Episode 4 is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Friends!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31512569/447758bbb5df98992f2328b4a4ac3c67b371da7d.jpg[/img]

Today you will step into uncharted territory for the fourth time. This journey will be much longer than the previous ones. This is where things might get a little frightening. You will become a cat, return to your childhood once more and finally leave the ship. Some answers can be found only outside the warm cabins. Will you help Oddy in his quest to find out what is going on aboard the scientific vessel? 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/645820/Odysseus_Kosmos_and_his_Robot_Quest_Episodes_1_4/

Just a reminder - you only pay once and get the WHOLE season in one pack. If you already have the second and third episodes, you don't need to purchase this episode, it should be available to you for free. If this is your first purchase, you will receive four episodes immediately and the fifth episode will be made available (for free) on the day of its release. 
Send the code to the address viktoria@herocraft.com

The surprises do not end there. How about a friendly competition with other players and a chance to become one of San Francisco's missing crew members? The first player to finish episode 4 and send us a special code generated by the game will earn this reward. We will 'pixelate' the winner's likeness and they will appear in episode 5.

Some more rewards are available for the first 10 people to send us a code - they will receive a special coupon for a free iOS version of Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest AND a bonus Steam key for Crazy Soccer - a fun football manager where you get to sling cows and meteors at the enemy team! Aaaaand that’s not all. Check out the strange mechanism in the screenshot below. We strongly advise you to find it in-game for an opportunity to unlock some fancy hats and go through this adventure in style!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31512569/9beb58ba4d8f0a13c4afb1bb016e23efd2913843.png[/img]

notes.title: Episode 3 has officially launched!
notes.content:
The mystery is becoming tangled (in a weird, yet funny way) aboard San-Francisco, a scientific vessel exploring the outer reaches of space.

Solving puzzles involving time and gravity comes easy to Odysseus, a lazy board engineer that has been stuck in space for several years. 

But what if the accidents are not accidental in nature? What if someone or something is behind Oddy's team vanishing on a mysterious expedition a long time ago? You have the key to unraveling the mystery.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/645820/Odysseus_Kosmos_and_his_Robot_Quest_Adventure_Game/

IMPORTANT REMINDER: 
Episode 1 of the adventure is [b]FREE[/b] until August 27th. If you haven't tried the game yet, now is a great chance to do it. And of course, the whole season also got a discount of 40% for those that want to follow Oddy and Barton on their adventures =)

notes.title: Odysseus Kosmos: Episode 2 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/65080c609de19681736dbd2d07271bb3ae64d70e.gif[/img]

It's time to talk about what happened to Oddy and what the mission of the space ship San Francisco is!
